scope: trusted inbox separation feasibility and history preservation planning

findings.legacyQuery: notifications.where(userId == currentUid).orderBy(createdAt desc); home badge also queries by userId alone

decision: Full inbox protection plus unchanged successful legacy writes cannot be guaranteed under the observed client contract without changing a constraint.
preferredCompleteArchitecture: Keep notifications as a server-only trusted projection to preserve read shape; move supported client intents to authenticated intake or rely on real source events. A limited app writer update is required to avoid old notification-write errors.
historyPlan: Preserve every original document, ID, version and read-state in an access-restricted archive before any move; independently validate provenance; retain unverifiable items without silently certifying or destroying them.
retirementPlan: Retain both Vercel deployments and Git; use the previously prepared reversible controls only under separate production approval.
